origin: Synthetic examples authored for Step 0; no copied judgment body or credentials.
verification: Static source review. Expected behavior is a contract for future tests, not evidence that an application implementation passes.

cases.legacy_behavior: Every corner-bracket expression is removed.
cases.expected: Recognize the reason heading and preserve unknown marked content with source spans.

cases.legacy_behavior: Literal lnfd becomes a newline.
cases.expected: Official-source text preserves literal lnfd; marker decoding belongs only to a legacy adapter.

cases.input:
이유에서 판사 갑의 행위를 검토한다.
판사 을
cases.legacy_behavior: Signature regex relies on lnfd and cannot generally classify real-newline signatures.
cases.expected: Preserve discussion of a judge in reasoning; classify only an identified signature region and retain original text.

cases.legacy_behavior: Whitespace parentheses are replaced with (그림).
cases.expected: Do not invent an image; retain source or record a neutral extraction warning.

cases.legacy_behavior: The bracketed legal qualification is removed.
cases.expected: Preserve the bracketed content.

cases.legacy_behavior: 〔14〕 becomes [13], while 〔13〕 has no replacement in this branch.
cases.expected: Preserve each original label and its correct numeric value.

cases.legacy_behavior: Length threshold excludes the short sentence.
cases.expected: Preserve a meaningful short disposition without a mandatory minimum length.

cases.legacy_behavior: More digits than non-digits can exclude the fragment.
cases.expected: Preserve the amount and sentence; a quality flag must not destroy source content.

cases.legacy_behavior: Global residue replacement removes a later identical sentence along with the consumed first sentence.
cases.expected: Use cursor slicing and retain repeated sentences at distinct offsets.

cases.legacy_behavior: The residual-tail length gate can discard one character. This fixture targets the tail gate in isolation, not a complete delimiter match.
cases.expected: Retain a one-character residual tail when the upstream splitter yields one.

cases.legacy_behavior: A shared buffer can attach A's text to B and emit it under B's identity.
cases.expected: No text crosses case or source-field boundaries; preserve each identity and tail.

cases.legacy_behavior: Final non-period buffer is not emitted.
cases.expected: Flush final content without inventing punctuation.

cases.legacy_behavior: Comma/parenthesis buffering can leave a final buffer unflushed.
cases.expected: Keep source text; flag unmatched punctuation without silently losing the tail.

cases.precondition: sen_phr_pair=True; current legacy main uses False
cases.legacy_behavior: Last unit is removed to make an even count.
cases.expected: Keep all three units.

cases.legacy_behavior: All-empty row for number 2 ends the loop before number 3.
cases.expected: Visit actual labels; preserve gaps and align only justified pairs.

cases.legacy_behavior: Only the first matched case number is returned.
cases.expected: Retain both docket numbers and the original citation.

cases.legacy_behavior: The character class admits literal pipe.
cases.expected: Reject as a valid parsed docket while preserving the original value and error.

cases.legacy_behavior: Missing/failed parsing uses 2072-01-01.
cases.expected: Use missing/invalid status; never fabricate a future date.

cases.legacy_behavior: A date-spacing-dependent court extraction can retain date text in the court.
cases.expected: Parse the compact date separately from the court.

cases.legacy_behavior: int(total/20)+1 gives two pages.
cases.expected: Use actual page size and stop safely on empty results.

cases.legacy_behavior: A singleton object is iterated as if it were a list of items.
cases.expected: Wrap a valid singleton object as one record.

cases.legacy_behavior: Missing prec is not handled as an empty page; the Step 0 audit initially also misclassified this and was corrected.
cases.expected: Absent prec is an empty page, not a null record or an invalid payload by itself.

cases.legacy_behavior: Some legacy flows can produce rows with missing fields; no valid issue-answer alignment follows from their presence alone.
cases.expected: Preserve case and issue candidate, mark answer alignment unmatched, and do not invent a gist or gold pair.
